entities.name: Stefano Gobbi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stefano Gobbi was an Italian Roman Catholic priest and mystic. He founded the worldwide Catholic movement, the Marian Movement of Priests following what he reported as an interior locution in 1972 at the shrine of Our Lady of Fatima.
